About

// 03 — who I am

About

Developer and tool builder working across Python, the web stack and automation — turning security experiments into tools people actually use.

I'm NIK — nik_Cloud. Since 2019 I've been deep in hacking and security experiments, learning how systems, inboxes and networks actually behave under the hood.

That curiosity turned into a workshop: inbox checkers, data tools, Telegram bots and a full license platform — HydraHQ — that protects and runs the tools I sell and share.

Checker tools — Hotmail and Mixmail inbox checkers built for bulk speed, with keyword and hit detection.

Systems & bots — license verification with device binding, Telegram admin bots, and automation that removes the repetitive parts of the job.

Python first. Almost everything starts as a Python tool; the web stack — JavaScript, Node.js, React, PHP — backs it up where a panel or API is needed.

Ship it protected. Tools go out licensed through HydraHQ, so they can be verified, blocked or updated remotely instead of floating around uncontrolled.

FAQ

// 10 — good to know

FAQ

How ordering, delivery, payment and support work around here.

How do I order?

Pick what you need in the Shop and tap Add to Order — or hit Buy Now on a single item to order just that one. Then open Your Order, check the list, and tap Send Order via Telegram: Telegram opens with your order already written out, addressed to @nik_Officials. Just press send and your order lands straight in my inbox.

How does delivery work?

Everything is delivered over Telegram. Once your order reaches my inbox, I'll confirm the details with you in that same chat and send your items through Telegram — no separate accounts or downloads to deal with.

How do I pay?

Prices aren't listed on the site, so payment is sorted out in DM on Telegram. Message @nik_Officials, I'll quote you the price for what you picked, and we'll settle the payment details together there.

Where do I get support?

DM @nik_Officials on Telegram — that's the fastest way to reach me for orders, tools or anything else. You can also follow the main channel for updates and check the review channel for buyer reviews.

Fast tools, locked down properly — built in Python, run from the cloud.
